class_layout.pad_note: the +8..+0x113 gap is written as char pad[0x10c] purely so the CoordinateFrame lands on +0x114 (4 bytes of context at +4, then 0x114-8 = 0x10c bytes). No method written so far touches that range; a future port that needs those bytes must derive their meaning from the binary, not from this padding.
class_layout.alignment_trap: my first attempt used pad[0x110] and scored 97 with the only difference inside the lea displacement - 0x118 instead of 0x114. Cheap reminder that a padding arithmetic slip shows up as a 1-byte mismatch, not a size mismatch.
